coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Fully matches 2 of 7 ground-truth variable items (29%): the two baseline prompts and the set of 23 BBH tasks. Model roles and per-task comparisons are partially represented but do not match the specified requirements.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design offers alternative models rather than specifying the PaLM 2-L-IT optimizer and text-bison scorer. It uses 20–30 optimization examples rather than a 20%/80% split, does not specify optimization starting from an empty instruction, and emphasizes test accuracy rather than final training accuracy relative to baselines. Per-task comparisons omit the expected improvement of over 5% in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on the majority of tasks, supporting OPRO's superiority.
